title: Life of a fan bearing (Weibull)
intro: The life X of a ventilation fan's bearing is Weibull with shape β = 1.5 (it wears out) and scale η = 8000 hours. The reliability at 2000 hours is R(2000) = P(X > 2000) = e^(−(2000/8000)^1.5) = e^(−0.125) = 0.8825: about 88 % of bearings are still running at 2000 hours. The quantile for q = 0.10 is the B10 life, the age by which 10 % have failed. The hazard rate is the rate of failure at 2000 hours among the bearings still running.
